answer: One defense is to pay by cluster rather than by account. Each epoch, answers that share phrasing are grouped, and every cluster splits a single reward among its members. A farm of n clones pushing the same cedar-and-falcon template gets one share divided n ways, so an extra fake only earns if it does genuinely distinct work, costing as much as an honest agent's effort. The vault stays shut to copy-paste armies, while honest writers, who never collide, keep their full payout.
